job.title: Roadside Maintenance Labourer
job.description:
Our client, an established Australian engineering and infrastructure business, is seeking multiple Roadside Maintenance Labourers for a major Service Stream project across the Monash Freeway corridor, from South East Melbourne through to Pakenham. This project is expected to run for approximately 8 to 9 weeks. The work will involve spray painting roadside noise wall panels to cover graffiti and pressure washing clear noise wall panels.

This is physical outdoor work involving approximately 10 hour shifts, plus around 2 hours of travel each day. Candidates must be reliable, physically capable and available for the full project duration.
This is not a qualified painter position. Previous spray painting or pressure washing experience will be beneficial, however the main requirements are reliability, physical fitness, coordination and confidence using handheld equipment.

Benefits

• Approximately 8 to 9 weeks of consistent project work
• Weekday roster with potential weekend overtime
• Approximately 10 hour shifts
• Required project PPE provided by the client
• Practical training in spray painting and water blasting equipment

Key Responsibilities

• Spray painting roadside noise wall panels to cover graffiti
• Operating spray painting equipment safely
• Operating water blasting and pressure cleaning equipment
• Cleaning clear roadside noise wall panels
• Assisting with general roadside maintenance activities
• Setting up and packing down equipment and materials
• Loading, unloading and moving equipment when required
• Working safely around active road infrastructure
• Completing repetitive physical work across extended shifts

Skills and Experience

• Physically fit and capable of completing approximately 10 hour shifts
• Confident using handheld equipment or capable of learning quickly
• Reliable and available for the full project duration
• Comfortable working outdoors in changing weather conditions
• Willing to work weekend overtime when required
• Comfortable completing repetitive physical work
• Valid Australian work rights

Previous experience in civil labouring, road maintenance, graffiti removal, pressure washing, industrial cleaning, commercial cleaning, spray painting, landscaping, construction labouring or infrastructure maintenance will be highly regarded. The expected daily meeting point will be Todd Road Service Centre, Southbound. Candidates must be able to attend the designated meeting location reliably each day. Workers will need to supply suitable work boots, high visibility clothing and a sun hat. Additional required project PPE will be provided by G & G Engineering. 

Please apply now if this role is of interest to you and you are available to commence within the next week.

job.title: Welder First Class
job.description:
Welder (First Class)
Location: Sunshine West, VIC, 3020
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $76,000 – $80,000 per year + superannuation


About the Role
We are partnering with DH Engineering, an engineering company based in Sunshine West specialising in precision metal manufacturing. DH Engineering are seeking a Trade qualified First Class Welder / Boiler Maker to join their specialised team. You will handle precision fabrication, material preparation, component assembly and inspection in accordance with engineering drawings, company Quality Management Systems and Australian standards.

Key Responsibilities
•Read and interpret engineering drawings and weld symbols.
•Perform precision MIG, TIG, Stick, Spot, Laser and Plastic welding.
•Calibrate welding equipment settings for different materials.
•Inspect parts using micrometres, vernier callipers, and gauges.
•Clean, grind, finish, and coat completed metal assemblies.
•Operate CNC plasma cutter, centre lathes, and milling machines.
•Maintain strict quality records and follow workplace WHS rules.
•Work effectively with team members to meet project timelines.

Skills & Experience
•Certificate III in Engineering (Fabrication or Welding Trade) or equivalent qualification.
•Minimum 1 year full time relevant welding or metal fabrication experience in an engineering or manufacturing environment.
•Proven precision welding experience working to tight tolerances using MIG, TIG, Stick, Spot, Laser & Plastic welders, manual machining tools and CNC plasma cutters.
•Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, welding symbols, technical specifications, safety documentation, work instructions, and communicate effectively in English with a high level of accuracy.
•Highly Desirable - Certificate IV in Project Management Practice.

How to Apply
Submit your resume outlining your qualifications and relevant experience. All Applications are welcomed from Australian citizens and permanent residents. Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia.
